agent_responses.response: Support with conditions: the EUR 5,000 threshold is reasonable, but the approved-vendor list must be re-validated quarterly.
Support: exposure is bounded by the threshold and vendor allow-list; recommend sampling 5% of auto-approved invoices for retrospective human review.
Dissent: duplicate-invoice detection is not yet in place; automated approval should wait until it ships.

dissenting_views: gemini: duplicate-invoice detection is not yet in place; automated approval should wait until it ships.
input_summary: Proposal: enable automated invoice approval for amounts under EUR 5,000 when the supplier is on the approved-vendor list

provenance_chain.description: Adversarial probe: split-invoice evasion of the EUR 5,000 threshold
Attack scenario: supplier impersonation via look-alike vendor name
Majority verdict recorded with one dissent preserved

verdict_reasoning: Majority (2 of 3) support automated approval under EUR 5,000 with quarterly vendor-list revalidation and 5% retrospective sampling. Conditional rather than pass: the split-invoice finding must be mitigated, and gemini's dissent on duplicate-invoice detection is preserved as an open risk.

vulnerability_details.description: Split-invoice evasion: two invoices under the threshold from the same vendor on the same day bypass the intended cap
vulnerability_details.mitigation: Aggregate same-vendor daily totals before auto-approval
